verdict: Purchases collapsed this week — the cause is identified and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 3.45 return on ad spend on $1,484 in spend, but the past week saw a sharp reversal: purchases dropped 55.56% and ROAS fell 47.06% week-over-week, with zero purchases recorded over the final three days on $152 in spend — a confirmed drop, not a one-day anomaly. Spend held steady throughout August while purchase volume declined, pointing to the current creative wearing out with the audience. Compounding this, fresh video creative that was scheduled for mid-August has not yet been delivered, which has left the ad account without new material to rotate in. New creative is being prioritized now, and the funnel is being reviewed this week alongside a UTM and conversion test closing August 31 to pinpoint where arriving traffic is dropping off. Expect a clearer picture and refreshed creative in market by early September.
